Compared with the manufacturer generic partial-protein-hydrolysate definition, this supports a broader material relation only: NARROW_MATCH / native broadMatch, preserving kgmicrobe.ingredient:peptone. The descriptor indexing annotation does not establish clinical use or approve an organism/assay role.

Printed page7 defines generic peptones as water-soluble partial protein hydrolysates from plant, yeast or animal sources and includes acid, base or enzyme processing. This supports broader Protein Hydrolysates membership without selecting feedstock, enzyme, supplier, lot, numerical composition or organism role.

The direct Peptones descriptor D010461 was assessed under native section3 exact-term precedence. The source-unspecified owner and two observations do not establish that complete narrower specification; manufacturer generic scope also includes base hydrolysis. The complete active NLM Peptones descriptor, its explicit Peptone entry term and preferred concept M0016245 support the ordinary generic material identity. The conventional partial-hydrolysis/solubility description does not create a new lot-specific assay gate when no different actual source preparation is established. This is not supplier-product or source-assay approval.

Printed page7 independently identifies generic peptones as water-soluble partial protein-hydrolysis products while explaining variable feedstocks and product profiles. Earlier process/precipitation-gate inference is superseded; no numeric composition or role is imported.
